detail.body:
## Background

[Nemo_CICD_Test failed](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/39121745769/job/117745057247) on PR #6537 when GitHub's jobs API returned HTTP 502. That PR is already merged.

## What changed

- Fetch one complete jobs snapshot, with at most three attempts and 5s/10s backoff.
- Reuse it for all failure/skip assertions and diagnostics; fail closed on exhausted retries or invalid responses.
- Return success for intentionally disabled tiers under `set -e`.
- Run shell regression coverage in the existing lint job. Test triggers and failure/skip policies are unchanged.

## Details

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Jobs API] --> B[Bounded fetch]
  B --> C[Validated snapshot]
  C --> D[Failure and tier-skip checks]
  B -->|Exhausted| E[Fail]
  D --> F[CI summary]
```

## Tested

- 31 shell regression cases passed: retry recovery/exhaustion, partial/invalid responses, failure conclusions, H100/GB200 expected and intentional skips.
- Existing cache-key, dependency-layer and queue-bypass checks passed. Signing was disabled only for disposable dependency-test fixture commits.
- All-files pre-commit, Bash syntax, YAML wiring and diff checks passed.
- Merge-tree validation against main `74dbbe81` passed; tree equals the candidate tree.
- Model/GPU tests excluded: no model code, dependencies or test-launch payload changed. Upstream exact-head CI pending.

@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+# Reuse one complete snapshot for every assertion and diagnostic. An API failure
+# must never be interpreted as zero failures, including after retry exhaustion.
+for attempt in 1 2 3; do
+  if jobs_json=$(gh run view "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" --json jobs); then
+    break
+  fi
+  if [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]; then
+    echo "Unable to retrieve workflow jobs after $attempt attempts" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  echo "Unable to retrieve workflow jobs (attempt $attempt); retrying" >&2
+  sleep "$((attempt * 5))"
+done
+
+# Reject empty or malformed responses rather than reporting a false success.
+if ! jq -e '.jobs | type == "array" and length > 0' <<< "$jobs_json" > /dev/null; then
+  echo "Invalid workflow jobs response" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+failed_jobs=$(jq '[.jobs[] | select(.status == "completed" and .conclusion != "success" and .conclusion != "skipped")] | length' <<< "$jobs_json")
+
+unexpected_skips=0
+check_tier_skips() {
+  local tier="$1" expect="$2"
+  if [ "$expect" != "true" ]; then
+    return 0
+  fi
+  local n
+  n=$(jq --arg p "${tier}_" '[.jobs[] | select(.name | startswith($p)) | select(.conclusion == "skipped")] | length' <<< "$jobs_json")
+  if [ "$n" -gt 0 ]; then
+    echo "❌ Found $n unexpectedly skipped ${tier} job(s):"
+    jq -r --arg p "${tier}_" '.jobs[] | select(.name | startswith($p)) | select(.conclusion == "skipped") | .name' <<< "$jobs_json"
+    unexpected_skips=$((unexpected_skips + n))
+  fi
+}
+
+check_tier_skips "L0" "$EXPECT_L0"
+check_tier_skips "L1" "$EXPECT_L1"
+check_tier_skips "L2" "$EXPECT_L2"
+if [[ "$IS_MEMBER" == "true" && "$DISABLE_GB200_TESTS" != "true" ]]; then
+  check_tier_skips "gb200_L0" "$EXPECT_L0"
+  check_tier_skips "gb200_L1" "$EXPECT_L1"
+  check_tier_skips "gb200_L2" "$EXPECT_L2"
+fi
+
+if [ "$failed_jobs" -gt 0 ]; then
+  echo "❌ Found $failed_jobs failed job(s):"
+  jq -r '.jobs[] | select(.status == "completed" and .conclusion != "success" and .conclusion != "skipped") | .name' <<< "$jobs_json"
+fi
+
+if [ "$failed_jobs" -gt 0 ] || [ "$unexpected_skips" -gt 0 ]; then
+  exit 1
+fi
+
+echo "✅ All previous jobs completed successfully"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.."
+mock_dir=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$mock_dir"' EXIT
+mkdir "$mock_dir/bin"
+cat > "$mock_dir/bin/gh" <<'EOF'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+[[ "$*" == "run view 123 --json jobs" ]]
+calls=$(cat "$MOCK_DIR/calls")
+calls=$((calls + 1))
+echo "$calls" > "$MOCK_DIR/calls"
+if [ "$calls" -le "$MOCK_FAILURES" ]; then
+  echo '{"jobs":['
+  echo 'HTTP 502: Server Error' >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+cat "$MOCK_DIR/jobs.json"
+EOF
+cat > "$mock_dir/bin/sleep" <<'EOF'
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+echo "$1" >> "$MOCK_DIR/delays"
+EOF
+chmod +x "$mock_dir/bin/gh" "$mock_dir/bin/sleep"
+export MOCK_DIR="$mock_dir" PATH="$mock_dir/bin:$PATH"
+export GITHUB_RUN_ID=123 GH_REPO=NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge
+
+# Exercise the command actually wired into the required summary job.
+summary_command=$(awk '
+  /^  Nemo_CICD_Test:/ { in_job=1; next }
+  in_job && /^  [[:alnum:]_-]+:/ { in_job=0 }
+  in_job && /^        run: \|/ { in_run=1; next }
+  in_run && /^          / { sub(/^          /, ""); print; next }
+  in_run { exit }
+' .github/workflows/cicd-main.yml)
+[[ "$summary_command" == '.github/scripts/check_workflow_result.sh' ]]
+grep -q '^          .github/scripts/test_workflow_result.sh$' .github/workflows/cicd-main.yml
+
+run_case() {
+  local label="$1" expected_exit="$2" expected_calls="$3" expected_delays="$4"
+  echo 0 > "$mock_dir/calls"
+  : > "$mock_dir/delays"
+  local actual_exit=0
+  bash -e -u -o pipefail -c "$summary_command" > "$mock_dir/output" 2>&1 || actual_exit=$?
+  if [[ "$actual_exit" != "$expected_exit" || "$(cat "$mock_dir/calls")" != "$expected_calls" \
+      || "$(tr '\n' ' ' < "$mock_dir/delays")" != "$expected_delays" ]]; then
+    echo "FAIL: $label (exit=$actual_exit, calls=$(cat "$mock_dir/calls"))" >&2
+    cat "$mock_dir/output" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  if [ "$expected_exit" -eq 0 ]; then
+    grep -q 'All previous jobs completed successfully' "$mock_dir/output"
+  elif grep -q 'All previous jobs completed successfully' "$mock_dir/output"; then
+    echo "FAIL: $label reported success" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  echo "PASS: $label"
+}
+
+export EXPECT_L0=true EXPECT_L1=false EXPECT_L2=false IS_MEMBER=true DISABLE_GB200_TESTS=false MOCK_FAILURES=0
+cat > "$mock_dir/jobs.json" <<'EOF'
+{"jobs":[{"name":"L0_test","status":"completed","conclusion":"success"},{"name":"L1_optional","status":"completed","conclusion":"skipped"},{"name":"Nemo_CICD_Test","status":"in_progress","conclusion":""}]}
+EOF
+run_case 'passing jobs with disabled tiers and summary in progress' 0 1 ''
+export MOCK_FAILURES=1
+run_case 'transient API failure then success' 0 2 '5 '
+export MOCK_FAILURES=2
+run_case 'two API failures then success' 0 3 '5 10 '
+export MOCK_FAILURES=3
+run_case 'API retry exhaustion fails closed' 1 3 '5 10 '
+grep -q 'Unable to retrieve workflow jobs after 3 attempts' "$mock_dir/output"
+export MOCK_FAILURES=0
+
+for conclusion in failure cancelled timed_out action_required stale startup_failure; do
+  printf '{"jobs":[{"name":"failed_test","status":"completed","conclusion":"%s"}]}\n' "$conclusion" > "$mock_dir/jobs.json"
+  run_case "$conclusion is still a failure" 1 1 ''
+  grep -q 'failed_test' "$mock_dir/output"
+done
+
+for tier in L0 L1 L2; do
+  export EXPECT_L0=false EXPECT_L1=false EXPECT_L2=false
+  export "EXPECT_$tier=true"
+  printf '{"jobs":[{"name":"%s_test","status":"completed","conclusion":"skipped"}]}\n' "$tier" > "$mock_dir/jobs.json"
+  run_case "$tier unexpected skip" 1 1 ''
+  grep -q "${tier}_test" "$mock_dir/output"
+  export "EXPECT_$tier=false"
+  run_case "$tier intentional skip" 0 1 ''
+
+  printf '{"jobs":[{"name":"gb200_%s_test","status":"completed","conclusion":"skipped"}]}\n' "$tier" > "$mock_dir/jobs.json"
+  export "EXPECT_$tier=true"
+  run_case "GB200 $tier unexpected skip" 1 1 ''
+  grep -q "gb200_${tier}_test" "$mock_dir/output"
+  export DISABLE_GB200_TESTS=true
+  run_case "GB200 $tier disabled" 0 1 ''
+  export DISABLE_GB200_TESTS=false IS_MEMBER=false
+  run_case "GB200 $tier non-member" 0 1 ''
+  export IS_MEMBER=true
+done
+
+for response in '' 'not json' '{}' '{"jobs":null}' '{"jobs":[]}' '{"jobs":{}}'; do
+  printf '%s\n' "$response" > "$mock_dir/jobs.json"
+  run_case "invalid response: $response" 1 1 ''
+done
